newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile buys 67 tanks from Belgium - report.
newsitem.headline: Chile buys 67 tanks from Belgium - report.

text.p: The Chilean army has bought 67 German-built battle tanks from Belgium and hopes to buy up to 200 more by the end of next year as part of plans to replace ageing weaponry, according to a newspaper report on Sunday.
The German government, which holds the licenses for the tanks, has given final approval to the sale of the Leopard-1 tanks from the Belgian armed forces, the daily El Mercurio reported.

Chile will pay Belgium no more than $15 million for the whole package, or about $200,000 per tank including spare parts, ammunition and training, said the Santiago newspaper, citing well-informed sources.

The tanks, which will equip two of Chile's 10 armored cavalry batallions, will go towards replacing the current fleet of up to 150 U.S.-built, World War Two-era Sherman tanks, about 80 M-24 tanks also built in the 1940s and a group of M-41 tanks dating from the 1950s and 1960s, said El Mercurio.

The tanks were likely to be sent to army bases in Chile's extreme south, near the city of Punta Arenas, because their wide traction makes them perform well in the area's boggy ground and snow, said the report.

Chile is already looking in Europe for between 150 and 200 more tanks of the same model and could buy them by the end of next year in the Netherlands or Italy, where this make of tank is being taken out of circulation, said the report.

Chile, which returned to civilian rule in 1990 after 17 years under the military, has been gradually replacing vintage weaponry with newer materiel, including a fleet of used Mirage fighter jets purchased in Belgium in 1995.
The report of the tank deal came at a time of growing concern over the potential for arms races in Latin America.

The Clinton administration is currently deciding whether to lift a virtual ban on sales of sophisticated U.S. weaponry to Latin America. That ban applies mainly to high-tech aircraft and would not ordinarily affect buying and selling of tanks.
